gen-gf-mali-fs-plein: Mali writes in loose, friendly pen strokes, never crowding its c tips. Mali does the casual charm, and Plein, a sans with a clear channel into each round letter, is built for a quick, easy visit.
gen-gf-mali-fs-recia: Loose, welcoming handwriting that never feels fussy or overworked on the page. Next to Mali's looseness, Recia's text serif adds a sharper, authoritative edge, its modulation faint until you look closely, with generous openings for brief text.
gen-gf-mali-plus-jakarta-sans: Mali writes casually, with a faint stress in its round letters. Plus Jakarta Sans draws monoline strokes with curve endings kept well apart, so reading feels precise and pleasant in modest helpings.
gen-gf-mali-space-grotesk: Relaxed, hand-written charm in Mali, its c tips never quite touching. And Space Grotesk, its sans-serif ribbon of constant width and breathing counters, stays comfortable when taken in sips.
gen-gf-margarine-fs-karma: Pencil-smooth lines and oversized lowercase make Margarine hard to ignore. Shrink Margarine and its swagger fades quietly beside Karma's trustworthy text serif, whose terminals stay clear of the stem.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-fs-karma: MedievalSharp stands tall, with short stems above and below its letters. Karma, a trustworthy serif with a calm modulation and terminals well clear of the stem, feels settled and traditional beside that crisp, commanding display.
gen-gf-merienda-fs-bespoke-sans: Hand-drawn friendliness, graceful and loose, is what Merienda does best. Bespoke Sans does the sharper, refined work, leaving generous room between curve ends and the stem, which is built for brief spells of reading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab feels bookish and dignified, a stretched-out serif with open counters that breathe into the surrounding white space. Metamorphous earns its keep big and short, commanding with its high-set midline.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-kiwi-maru: Generous sidebearings and a high-set midline give Metamorphous a stately stride. Kiwi Maru settles in lower, with terminals stopping far from the stem and generous letterspace, an editorial counterweight to that stately stride.
